messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate in us-west-2 (gateway 502/504 spike). SLO risk: increased error rate >3% for 5m. Paging #incidents and oncall: @jun-runtime. Incident ID: INC-20260315-01

maria-sre: acked. oncall jun-runtime paged. I'm joining. any customer impact visible? :rotating_light:

jun-runtime: oncall here. seeing 5xx and backend timeouts. metrics: batcher_queue_length (s-17) spiked from ~20->900 in ~2m, batch wait latency rising, head-of-line blocking. KV cache prefetch growth on same shard. starting live timeline. set priority to P1. tagging sophie.

sophie-eng: on it. initial hypothesis: large long-running requests are holding batcher slots -> head-of-line. can we evict stuck requests and enable fallback small model route? Also confirm whether autoscale kicked.

luca-ops: autoscale didn't trigger; pool capacity hit (~95% GPUs in dedicated pool). request routing still to us-west-2 primary. sending commands to inspect scheduler shard:
```
redwoodctl sched inspect --shard s-17 --fields queue_len,active_batches,kv_cache_sz
# => queue_len=912, active_batches=64, kv_cache_sz=78GB
```

jun-runtime: running eviction on shard s-17 now: `redwoodctl sched evict --shard s-17 --policy aggressive --age 120s --dry-run=false` 

sophie-eng: good. also enabling model-fallback for route `/v1/generate` to `gptf-small-quant` for new requests while we stabilize.

jun-runtime: applied fallback routing: `redwoodctl route set-fallback /v1/generate --model gptf-small-quant --percent 40` -> returning success. starting to see queue drain slowly.

kai-support: seeing customer reports starting ~11:02 - some streaming sessions aborted with 502. rough estimate: 3.9% of requests in region failing, top customers A,B,C impacted. updating status page: "Partial service degradation in US-West for text generation". :warning:

maria-sre: temporary mitigation: reduce batcher max_batch_size and increase concurrency to reduce blocking. applying config change to batcher pool s-17: 
```
redwoodctl config set batcher.s-17.max_batch_size=32
redwoodctl config set batcher.s-17.max_concurrency=10
```

luca-ops: config applied. observing drop in batch wait time from 980ms -> 240ms across next minute.

jun-runtime: eviction freed ~420 requests. queue_len now 340 and trending down. 5xx rate falling but still above SLO (1.6%). continuing to monitor. rolling restarts of scheduler replicas planned if not recovered in 10m.

sophie-eng: note: KV cache growth may be due to a specific model version (m-20260310-large). pinning routing away from that model for now.

jun-runtime: pinned: `redwoodctl route pin /v1/generate --exclude m-20260310-large`.

kai-support: status page updated with ETA ~15m. customers A/B given mitigation plan and advised to retry. :thumbsup:

maria-sre: we should also enable spillover to eu-west-1 to reduce load here. starting reroute: `redwoodctl route spillover /v1/generate --to-region eu-west-1 --percent 20`.

jun-runtime: spillover accepted. observing traffic shift. 5xx now 0.8% and timeouts back to acceptable band. marking immediate impact resolved. keep incident open for follow-up RCA.

sophie-eng: action items: 1) RCA on why autoscale didn't trigger 2) tune default batcher thresholds 3) add guardrails for KV cache growth 4) add runbook steps for eviction + fallback routing. I'll own RCA.

maria-sre: oncall handoff: @jun-runtime to @maria-sre at 11:35. leaving summary in channel. Thanks all. :heart:

jun-runtime: handing off to maria-sre. last checks green. closing page to oncall rotations. will keep monitoring for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration: 00:33. Postmortem requested.
